QuestInfo.name: Unwritten Records
QuestInfo.0: If the books you're looking for aren't in #m222020000#, someone must be working to erase history. But who?!
QuestInfo.1: #m222020000# didn't have the records. According to #p2040052#, the previous librarian moved the books to storage to make room. It would be worth checking out the #bLibrary Vault#k.\n\n#rTip: If you aren't able to defeat Wiz the Librarian, you must forfeit the quest and do it again.
QuestInfo.2: There are traces of cinder in the Library Vault, precisely where the records of the heroes were kept. Someone is tampering with the history books!

0.0: You have a very young face to be looking for such old books. The records on the Black Mage and the heroes should still be in-house, but I don't know that they will be easy to find...
0.1: After all, our facilities do not have unlimited space. Old, unpopular books often end up collecting dust in the #bLibrary Vault#k.
0.2: Would you like to go there now? I'm afraid I will not have time to show you around, but you may be able to find what you're looking for.

yes.0: The vault is opened to any one who needs it. That is the law of #m222020000#.

no.0: Fair enough. May I suggest something from the Hungry Potter series instead?

1.0: Wha-what... happened? I suppose I have been overworking myself a bit lately. I do find the book vapors get to my head after a time...\r\n#L0##bYou don't remember what just happened?#l\n#k
1.1: I am afraid I do not! Things turned blurry and I remember a vivid dream of being beaten to a pulp. Did I hit my head when I fainted? It's quite sore... \r\n#L0##bI, uh... no, you landed very softly on a pile of papers. It was pretty graceful.#l\n#k
1.2: How embarrassing! It was if my body was not my own for a moment. Perhaps it's time I started looking for my successor. I'm getting so old...  \r\n#L0##b(Something weird shot out of Wiz when I knocked him out. What kind of sorcery can control a man like that?)#l\n#k
1.3: I'm sorry we could not find the book you wanted. I suppose I will have to take greater care of the vault, seeing as books have begun spontaneously combusting within. I'm just glad we did not lose the whole room!
